import re, sys
from datetime import date
from collections import defaultdict
SRC = r"C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\prompt-evals-session-6zm79ggx\personal_expenses.txt"
MON = {'jan':1,'feb':2,'mar':3,'apr':4,'may':5,'jun':6,'jul':7,'aug':8,'sep':9,'oct':10,'nov':11,'dec':12}
DATE_PATS = [
    (r'\b(2026)-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b', lambda m: (int(m[2]), int(m[3]))),
    (r'\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})(?:/(\d{2,4}))?\b', lambda m: (int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (r'\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b', lambda m: (int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (r'\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b', lambda m: (MON[m[1].lower()], int(m[2]))),
]
AMT = re.compile(r'(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})\s*$')

CATS = {
 'Groceries': ["Trader Joe's","Aldi","Kroger","Costco","Whole Foods"],
 'Eating Out / Coffee': ["Local Coffee Co","Starbucks","Chipotle","McDonald's","Rustic Tap Brewery","Panera Bread",
                         "Sushi Kame","Thai Orchid","Bagel Corner","Luigi's Pizza"],
 'Shopping': ["Amazon","Best Buy","Home Depot","Target","REI","Barnes & Noble","Old Navy","IKEA","Return processed - REI"],
 'Gas': ["Shell","Chevron","BP Gas"],
 'Transport / Parking / Auto': ["Lyft","Uber","City Parking Authority","Jiffy Lube"],
 'Subscriptions': ["iCloud+ 200GB","Amazon Prime","Netflix","Spotify Premium","Planet Fitness App"],
 'Phone / Internet': ["Xfinity Internet","Verizon Wireless"],
 'Health / Fitness': ["Planet Fitness","Riverside Physical Therapy","Dr. Hensley Dental Copay","Walgreens","CVS Pharmacy"],
 'Entertainment': ["Steam","Spotify Concert","AMC Theatres","Bowl-O-Rama","Ticketmaster"],
 'Travel': ["Delta Air Lines","Airport Parking","Marriott","Hertz Rental Car"],
 'UNCATEGORIZED': ["Zelle Payment","ATM Cash Withdrawal","Venmo - Sam","PayPal Transfer"],
}
M2C = {m:c for c,ms in CATS.items() for m in ms}

def parse(line):
    s = line.strip()
    m = AMT.search(s)
    # amount may sit mid-line when date is in a trailing "(...)"
    tail = re.search(r'\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*$', s)
    datestr = None
    if tail and not m:
        datestr, s = tail[1], s[:tail.start()]
        m = AMT.search(s)
    if not m: return None
    amt = float(m[3]) * (-1 if (m[1] or m[2]) else 1)
    rest = s[:m.start()]
    md = None
    for src in ([datestr] if datestr else []) + [rest]:
        for pat, fn in DATE_PATS:
            dm = re.search(pat, src)
            if dm:
                md = fn(dm)
                if src is rest: rest = rest[:dm.start()] + rest[dm.end():]
                break
        if md: break
    if not md: return None
    merch = re.sub(r'\(\s*\)', '', rest)
    merch = re.sub(r'^[\s\-|:,]+|[\s\-|:,]+$', '', merch).strip()
    merch = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', merch)
    # strip leftover separators like " - " / "--" at ends again after inner removal
    merch = re.sub(r'^(?:-|\||:|,|\s)+|(?:-|\||:|,|\s)+$', '', merch)
    if merch == 'Return processed - REI': pass
    return date(2026, *md), merch, amt

rows, unparsed = [], []
for n, line in enumerate(open(SRC, encoding='utf-8'), 1):
    if not line.strip(): continue
    p = parse(line)
    if p is None or p[1] not in M2C:
        unparsed.append((n, line.rstrip(), p)); continue
    d, merch, amt = p
    rows.append(dict(line=n, date=d, merch=merch, amt=amt, cat=M2C[merch], raw=line.rstrip()))
EOF
